segments.text: Tony Bittner, I came before you guys a year ago.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I'm a nurse, or at least I was at Rady Children's in the cardiovascular intensive care unit until Nathan and his misinformation pandemic caused me to lose my job.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I took care of those children who came in with myocarditis after the vaccine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And I talked to the doctors because I was a charge nurse saying, why aren't we reporting these to bears?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Who is going to report these to bears?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: It was an unspoken thing that we were not allowed to talk about openly on the unit.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I've worked for 13 years in this community, taking care of some of the sickest patients.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The day before I was taken away from my position, I was actively giving compressions to a child, pushing Abby, pushing calcium into his veins to keep him alive.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And we did.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And he went home.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And yet,
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I was ridiculed by those who were supposed to be my colleagues and my friends.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I am the face of your misinformation campaign, Nathan.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I am the one who lost my career in pediatric cardiovascular ICU care.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I took care of children who had COVID.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I never got COVID in the hospital.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I tested twice a week.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I wore my PPE because I loved my job.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And I love this community.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Thank you.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
